environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running Ubuntu 20.04 with Rails 6.1 monolith deployed via Capistrano. Application runs as 'deploy' user with full filesystem access. PostgreSQL 13 on same host. No WAF, no parameter filtering middleware. Instance in public subnet with direct internet access via EIP. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.

config.network: public subnet, EIP, SG allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
